description_en: Retrieves the details of an offline compute node
description_zh: 获取离线计算任务详情
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public get-batch-task-info --op-tenant-id 30001011 --project-id 131211211 --file-id 12113111 --env dev --include-all-up-streams true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetBatchTaskInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the project to which the node belongs
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The node ID in the directory tree
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en:
The environment identifier. Valid values:

- dev
- prod

Default value: dev
parameters.help_zh: 环境标识: dev、prod，默认值为dev
parameters.name: env

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include all upstream nodes, including invalid dependencies. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含完整的上游节点（包括无效依赖），默认false
parameters.name: include_all_up_streams
